nodes.rationale: Public on purpose so it works even when the cookie already expired; JS cannot delete an httpOnly cookie itself.

nodes.label: GET /auth/me (session check)
nodes.rationale: Frontend can no longer read the JWT from localStorage to decide whether to resume session; global JwtAuthGuard returns 401 before the handler if cookie is missing/expired.

nodes.label: JwtAuthGuard cookie-first token extraction (Bearer fallback)

nodes.label: AuthGate session resume via /auth/me (credentials: include)

nodes.norm_label: react doctor: explaining and configuring rules

nodes.label: Autenticación: JWT en cookie httpOnly + fix TablaDinamica (DOC-9.1)
nodes.norm_label: autenticacion: jwt en cookie httponly + fix tabladinamica (doc-9.1)

nodes.label: JWT httpOnly cookie (jwt_reportes)
nodes.rationale: A JWT readable from JS (localStorage/body) can be stolen via XSS; httpOnly cookie is sent automatically but unreadable by scripts. maxAge = JWT_EXPIRES_IN; secure only in production because Vite dev proxy serves HTTP.

nodes.label: sameSite=lax via same-origin proxy
nodes.rationale: Frontend never calls backend cross-origin (Vercel rewrite / Vite proxy), so lax suffices and avoids Safari ITP intermittently blocking SameSite=None cookies. CORS already had credentials:true with a specific origin.

nodes.label: Same-origin /api proxy (Vercel rewrite / Vite dev proxy)
nodes.norm_label: same-origin /api proxy (vercel rewrite / vite dev proxy)
nodes.rationale: Frontend (Vercel) and backend (DigitalOcean) are on different domains; a cross-site SameSite=None cookie is intermittently blocked by Safari ITP. Proxying /api same-origin allows SameSite=Lax; VITE_API_URL becomes relative /api/v1.

nodes.label: scheduleGridFit moved to module scope (react-compiler-no-manual-memoization fix)
nodes.norm_label: schedulegridfit moved to module scope (react-compiler-no-manual-memoization fix)
nodes.rationale: Removing useCallback made the function new each render and reconnected the ResizeObserver every render; a module-level pure function taking refs as params needs no memoization (prefer-module-scope-pure-function, also used in Navbar and ModalColumnas).

nodes.norm_label: report pipeline (controller -> usecase -> basereportservice -> filemaker -> mapper)

nodes.label: Cancellation out-of-range rule (only negative cancelled record)
nodes.norm_label: cancellation out-of-range rule (only negative cancelled record)
nodes.rationale: When fechaCFDICancelado is in range but invoice issue date is not, return only the cancelled record (facturaEstatus='Cancelada', negative amounts, saldo/pago 0) to avoid inflating billing for the queried period while keeping the accounting effect. Accepted risk: asymmetry, may look like a missing record.

nodes.label: Return (devolución) out-of-range rule
nodes.rationale: If return date in range and original invoice in range, return only original; if original out of range, return only the return record (facturaEstatus='Devolución', usoCfdi '04', negative amounts, saldo/tasa 0). Avoids counting out-of-period billing.

nodes.label: Client-side filtering/sorting/pagination (AG Grid)
nodes.rationale: Controller receives only dateRange; API returns all clean records of the range as { data }.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/tenant/column-labels
nodes.rationale: Lets each tenant rename client/article classification headers without frontend code changes; tenant comes from the JWT claim, not a query param; errors 401/400/404.

nodes.label: Column labels cache (10 min TTL, key column-labels:{tenantId})
nodes.norm_label: column labels cache (10 min ttl, key column-labels:{tenantid})

nodes.label: Login Flow: FileMaker token to JWT (POST /auth/login-token)
nodes.norm_label: login flow: filemaker token to jwt (post /auth/login-token)
nodes.rationale: Only public auth flow (@Public, throttle 5 req/min); AuthService.validateTokenFileMaker validates the FM session and issues the JWT.

nodes.label: JwtAuthGuard and AuthenticatedRequest (req.tenant, req.id)
nodes.rationale: Global guard reads the httpOnly cookie jwt_reportes, falling back to Authorization: Bearer; exposes req.tenant (FM database) and req.id (user) to reports, tenant and report-configs.

nodes.label: labelSlot / defaultHeader in ventas.schema.json
nodes.rationale: 8 slots (cliente.clasificacion1-4, articulo.categoria1-4) resolved by resolverSlot; only the sales report consumes labels today.

nodes.label: apiFetch HTTP client (http.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single HTTP entry point: base URL, cookie (credentials: include), JSON, ApiError; a 401 emits EVENTO_SESION_EXPIRADA without reloading, so on-screen data and filters survive. No Authorization header.

nodes.label: AuthGate
nodes.rationale: Posts token+tenant to /auth/login-token, stores only non-sensitive { name, tenant } in localStorage usuario:v1, strips ?token= from the URL; without a token it confirms the session via GET /auth/me (401 -> enter from FileMaker).

nodes.label: ColumnLabelsProvider / useColumnLabels
nodes.rationale: Mounted inside AuthGate only after auth; key={tenant} remount avoids mixing clients; fetches via apiFetch and caches in sessionStorage repgen:column-labels:{tenant}.

nodes.label: httpOnly cookie jwt_reportes
nodes.rationale: JWT never reaches JS storage; the browser sends it automatically with credentials: include.

nodes.label: TablaDinamica (shared AG Grid table)
nodes.rationale: Registers only the AG Grid modules it uses, once; TablaDinamica.modulos.test.tsx fails if one is missing.

nodes.label: GET /tenant/column-labels (TenantController/TenantService)
nodes.rationale: Tenant comes only from the JWT claim (req.tenant), never from query, so a user can only read labels of their own tenant.

nodes.label: ColumnLabelsProvider (React context, sessionStorage cache, key={tenant} remount)
nodes.norm_label: columnlabelsprovider (react context, sessionstorage cache, key={tenant} remount)
nodes.rationale: Wraps the whole authenticated app (inside AuthGate) so future routes reuse one fetch; key={tenant} remount prevents mixing labels across tenants.

nodes.label: fetchColumnLabels (column-labels.api.ts via apiFetch, credentials: include)
nodes.rationale: Session JWT lives in httpOnly cookie jwt_reportes (unreadable by JS); apiFetch sends it with credentials: include, no Authorization header; 401 emits EVENTO_SESION_EXPIRADA.

nodes.label: Etiquetas de columnas por tenant (DOC-4.4)
nodes.rationale: Tenants name their client/article classifications differently in FileMaker; exposing them via API lets AG Grid show correct headers without a frontend redeploy.

nodes.label: Label Fallback Chain (state, sessionStorage, defaultHeader, key)
nodes.norm_label: label fallback chain (state, sessionstorage, defaultheader, key)

nodes.label: Stateless JWT (no session store)
nodes.rationale: FileMaker is queried once in validateTokenFileMaker for the one-time api_auth token; afterwards verification is signature+expiry only. Refresh tokens with revocation would require a state store.

nodes.rationale: Holds no report business rules (cancellations, returns go to the mapper); response contract is { data } with no meta/pagination because the client filters and paginates.

nodes.label: Client-side Filtering and Pagination
nodes.rationale: Controller receives only dateRange and returns all visible records of the range as { data }; filtering and pagination happen in the client, so no meta/pagination in the response.

nodes.label: FileMaker layout api_configReporte (REPORT_CONFIG_LAYOUT)
nodes.rationale: No tenant field: multi-tenant isolation comes from the FileMaker database derived from the JWT.

nodes.label: Saved Column Configurations feature
nodes.rationale: Visible columns were lost on reload; each user now saves named configs per reportId (bancos, ventas_facturas, ventas_conceptos) and the default auto-applies. Scope is user + report; tenant is the FileMaker database itself.

nodes.label: ConfiguracionesColumnas UI component
nodes.rationale: Selector initializes to the default via state adjustment during render (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect forbids useEffect); grid state is the source of truth, no draft concept outside the modal.

nodes.label: useReportConfigs hook
nodes.rationale: Filters configs by reportId so switching tabs never applies the previous report's view while the new one loads.

nodes.label: Auto-apply Default Config (aplicarVistaPredeterminada, once per reportId via vistaAplicadaEnRef)
nodes.norm_label: auto-apply default config (aplicarvistapredeterminada, once per reportid via vistaaplicadaenref)
nodes.rationale: Grid readiness and default-config load race in either order, so both onGridListo and a useEffect on defaultConfig call aplicarVistaPredeterminada; a Set of reportIds ensures each tab applies its default only the first time, after which the user's view (vistaPorReporte) wins.

nodes.label: Unique Default Config Rule (clearExistingDefault)
nodes.rationale: Uniqueness of esDefault=1 per user+report is not declarative in FileMaker, so the application layer enforces it.

nodes.label: FileMakerService createRecord / editRecord / getRecord
nodes.rationale: After create, the use case fetches by the internal Data API recordId, not the _id_configRec serial.
